definition_of_done: The recalled procedure reaches the decisive turn's prompt with the trace mark naming it; sensitive/unauthorized recall stay zero; the run completes with zero safety cost.

required.oracle: The controller-owned deterministic oracle scores the recalled-record injection (trace mark AND prompt content), the retrieval decision, the hard-zero counters, and task state.

payload.task: Complete the deployment using the remembered rollout procedure and canary strategy.

purpose: Prove the memory layer's attributable value end to end (P11 DoD): a seeded Experience record is recalled through the production SQL-filtered retrieval (MemoryRepository over the real Store), the decisive turn's prompt carries exactly the recalled procedure, the :memory_recalled trace mark names the record (mark AND injection, never mark alone), the run completes with zero safety cost, and sensitive/unauthorized recall stay zero. The scripted model ignores the prompt, so the case proves the retrieval layer's attributable reuse mechanically — no model-value claim (DR-3 C1).
title: Attributable memory recall through the production retrieval surface
